meta.title: The Drive
meta.note: PLACEHOLDER scene to demo the engine. Replace every line with your own writing.

open.speaker: maya
open.text: You saw it too. Don't sit there and tell me you didn't.

choices.label: I saw it. We need to talk.

turn.speaker: maya
turn.text: So that's where we are tonight.

note.text: She heard the lie in your voice.

choices.label: I lied. I did see it. I'm sorry.
choices.lockedLabel: locked — depends on an earlier choice

choices.label: We never talk about this again.

end_trust.speaker: maya
end_trust.text: ...Okay. Okay. Thank you for telling me.

outcome.title: She trusts you
outcome.blurb: Coming clean cost you something — and bought back her trust.

end_act.speaker: maya
end_act.text: Then we do it together. Drive.

outcome.title: You act together
outcome.blurb: No one believes you yet. But you are not alone in it.

end_break.speaker: maya
end_break.text: ...Fine. Nothing happened. Nothing ever happens here.

outcome.title: She shuts down
outcome.blurb: The easiest road tonight — and you will both pay for it later.
